usage: coexistence.py [-h] --frontend-jar FRONTEND_JAR
                      (--frontend-sha256 FRONTEND_SHA256 | --artifact-receipt ARTIFACT_RECEIPT)
                      --patch PATCH

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --frontend-jar FRONTEND_JAR
  --frontend-sha256 FRONTEND_SHA256
                        Explicit frontend digest used with the exact pinned
                        compiler proof
  --artifact-receipt ARTIFACT_RECEIPT
                        The same source-qualified ARTIFACTS.json used for the
                        linked compiler proof
  --patch PATCH
